mapper.select: /* isry.drmgs.lcgovbiz.mapper.LcgovBizSprtPreconMapper.selectClienaInfo - 응용2팀 정원제 */ SELECT T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , CASE WHEN T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.TRPR_NM_ENCPT ELSE T3.FLNM_ENCPT END AS CLIENA_NM /* 내담자 이름 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.TRPR_BRTH_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BRTH_YY_MM_DAY /* 내담자 생년월일 */ , CASE WHEN T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.SXDC_SE_CD ELSE T3.SXDC_SE_CD END AS SXDC /* 내담자 성별 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.CASE_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CASE_BGNG_DD /* 사례시작일 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.CASE_TRMN_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CASE_END_DD /* 사례종료일 */ , T5.FLNM_ENCPT AS CONSTT_NM /* 상담자 이름 */ , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEB120 T8 /* 서비스 사업 대상자 */ , SDA400 T9 /* 서비스사업 */ , SDA420 T18 /* 서비스실행사업 */ WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T8.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T8.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T8.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T8.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T18.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND T18.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T9.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND T18.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD = '05' ) AS CASE_COUNT /* 사례수 */ FROM SEB100 T1 /* 사례기본 */ , SEA200 T2 /* 대상자정보 */ , SCA300 T3 /* 개인정보 */ , SEB150 T4 /* 사례담당자 */ , SCA100 T5 /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO(+) AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T4.CASE_PIC_NO = T5.ENFSN_NO AND T4.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* isry.drmgs.lcgovbiz.mapper.LcgovBizSprtPreconMapper.selectIndivSprvtList - 응용2팀 정원제 */ SELECT T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스 실행 번호 */ , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T6.PIC_NO) AS CONSTT_NM /* 상담사 이름 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2. SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SRVC_PVSN_PRD /* 서비스제공기간 */ , T3.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 지원서비스(제공자원명) */ FROM SEB510 T1 , SEB500 T2 , SDA100 T3 , SDA420 T4 , SDA400 T5 , (SELECT * FROM SDA110 WHERE PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') T6 WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T1.RESRCE_NO = T2.RESRCE_NO AND T2.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T3.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND T4.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND T3.RESRCE_NO = T6.RESRCE_NO(+) AND T3.GR_TRGT_SRVC_YN = 'N' AND T4.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD = '05' AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* isry.drmgs.lcgovbiz.mapper.LcgovBizSprtPreconMapper.selectGrDscsnList - 응용2팀 정원제 */ SELECT T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO /* 서비스 실행 번호 */ , (SELECT FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T6.PIC_NO) AS CONSTT_NM /* 상담사 이름 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2. SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SRVC_PVSN_PRD /* 서비스제공기간 */ , T3.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 지원서비스(제공자원명) */ FROM SEB510 T1 , SEB500 T2 , SDA100 T3 , SDA420 T4 , SDA400 T5 , (SELECT * FROM SDA110 WHERE PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') T6 WHERE T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T1.RESRCE_NO = T2.RESRCE_NO AND T2.RESRCE_NO = T3.RESRCE_NO AND T3.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND T4.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T5.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND T3.RESRCE_NO = T6.RESRCE_NO(+) AND T3.GR_TRGT_SRVC_YN = 'Y' AND T4.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD = '05' AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N'
